title: Selected finite affine gluing presentation
statement:
Let $S$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]; quasi-compact means that every open cover of its underlying space has a finite subcover. A selected finite affine gluing presentation $\mathsf G_S$ consists of the following chosen data.

Choose a finite affine open cover $S=\bigcup_{a=1}^nU_a$, with $n\geq0$. For each ordered pair $(a,b)$, choose a finite affine open cover $(U_{ab,r})_r$ of $U_a\cap U_b$. For each $U_{ab,r}$ choose a finite cover by basic opens of $U_a$ contained in $U_{ab,r}$ and a finite cover by basic opens of $U_b$ contained in $U_{ab,r}$. Record these covers, all their index sets, the chart rings $A_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_S)$ for the chosen affine opens $V$, their affine identifications $V\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(A_V)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and the elements inverted in the basic-open descriptions. Here, in an affine chart $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, a basic open means $D_A(f)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}(A):f\notin\mathfrak p\}$ for $f\in A$, and $A_f=A[1/f]$ denotes localization [def-weil-ring-localization-away].

Put $W_{ab}=U_a\cap U_b$, regarded as an open subscheme of $U_a$, and let $\varphi_{ab}:W_{ab}\to W_{ba}$ be the identification of the two restrictions of $S$. Record both directions of these overlap maps, their restrictions to the selected affine opens (and the resulting contravariant ring homomorphisms), and their identity, inverse, and triple-cocycle equalities. Explicitly, $W_{aa}=U_a$, $\varphi_{aa}=\mathrm{id}_{U_a}$, $\varphi_{ba}\circ\varphi_{ab}=\mathrm{id}_{W_{ab}}$, and for every triple $(a,b,c)$,
$$
\varphi_{ab}^{-1}(W_{ba}\cap W_{bc})=W_{ab}\cap W_{ac},\qquad
\varphi_{bc}\circ\varphi_{ab}=\varphi_{ac}\quad\text{on }W_{ab}\cap W_{ac}.
$$
The finite record includes these equalities as equalities of maps with the displayed domains, with their restrictions on the chosen covers. Finiteness refers to the index sets and lists of rings, elements, maps, and map equalities; it does not require the chart rings to be finitely generated or the map equalities to be tested on finite ring-generating sets. Empty covers are allowed for empty overlaps. The notation $\mathsf G_S$ retains all these choices.

split_report.summary: Split the definition into its existing notions: scheme/affine open, quasi-separated scheme, affine spectrum and ring localization. Expanded the selected cover data and the identity, inverse and cocycle equations without adding a finite-generation assumption. No new node is necessary. Overlap properties and recovery by gluing remain in the already imported properties lemma; they are not proof dependencies of this definition.
split_report.blueprint: The definition realizes the first two sentences of the unit proof: a finite affine cover and finite affine refinements of its overlaps. Its three data paragraphs spell out the imported definition (order 332), including the recorded chart rings, basic-open elements, both overlap directions and identity/inverse/triple equations. It does not perform the subsequent coefficient-stage descent. This is an imported definition, so blueprint.from remains null; whole-blueprint searches found no other node defining the same record.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Select a finite affine cover
$S=\bigcup_{a=1}^nU_a$. For every pair $(a,b)$, select a finite affine
cover $(U_{ab,r})_r$ of $U_a\cap U_b$ and then finite basic-open covers of
each $U_{ab,r}$ as an open of $U_a$ and of $U_b$. Record the resulting
chart rings, inverted elements, two directions of each overlap map, and the
finite lists of identity, inverse, and triple-cocycle equalities. Call this
finite record $\mathsf G_S$.
